test_case.purpose: Validate every approved 1DPC DIMM for 12 hours at measured 40C and +5% 5V/3.3V rails with complete memory coverage and no disallowed training, ECC/RAS, SST, BMC or stability failure.
required_package: Pinned SST memory profile and allocation/coverage floor
ESD operator and hardware/environment restoration plan
test_case.test_command: Qualified operator powers down/discharges under ESD, records and installs the approved 1DPC population, boots and verifies training/SMBIOS/EDAC inventory, preserves baselines, ramps to approved 40C/+5% rails, and runs the pinned SST profile for 12 hours while recording allocation coverage, per-channel ECC/RAS, thermals, heartbeat and BMC events. Restore nominal environment and required reference population, then verify health.
test_case.expected_result: Every expected DIMM trains and remains visible, approved memory coverage is sustained for 12 hours in-tolerance, no disallowed corrected/uncorrected ECC, RAS/MCE, SST, BMC, hang or BSOD occurs, and restoration/post-health succeed.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires slot-level population and training proof, complete approved allocation/duration, continuous margin trace, per-channel error oracle and restoration. Total capacity alone, fewer trained DIMMs, remote-only stress, cleared logs or a short run cannot pass.
safety_gate: Powered-down ESD service with labels preserved
Abort on training loss, ECC/RAS/OOM/thermal limit or heartbeat failure
Preserve evidence; controlled nominal/hardware restoration; no auto-retry
test_case.recovery: On POST/training, memory, environment or health fault, stop workload, preserve slot and error evidence, return the environment to nominal, power down under ESD for approved population restoration, revalidate inventory/health and do not automatically rerun.
